verbs.name: generate.list
verbs.description: List the built-in Generate catalog: reusable native Cut definitions plus promoted rich ShellX Motion families that preview and insert as receipt-bound rendered media. Pure READ: no project required, no op, no checkpoint. This is NOT assets.generate; it returns typed template metadata for editable or linked timeline generation.

kind.description: Filter by template kind. Omit or pass all for every kind.

source.description: Filter by template source. Builtin templates are supported; project/user sources are reserved for future save/import support.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over id, title, summary, and tags.

verbs.result: {templates:[{id, source, kind, title, summary, tags, params:{type,required,default?,minimum?,maximum?,step?}, capabilities, available}]} — read-only discovery surface for the Generate module.

verbs.name: generate.describe
verbs.description: Describe ONE Generate template in full before preview/insert: bounded params (including decimal minimum/maximum/step), defaults, lowering verb/args, capabilities, and verification expectations. Pure READ. NOT_FOUND for an unknown id (ids come from generate.list).

id.description: Generate template id from generate.list, for example builtin.lower-third.clean.

verbs.result: {id, source, kind, title, summary, tags, params, defaults, capabilities, lowering:{verb,args}, verification}.

verbs.name: generate.preview
verbs.description: Render a non-mutating PNG evidence frame for one Generate template after resolving params and lowering args. Pure preview: no project required, no op, no checkpoint. With an open project it writes into <project>/frames and returns a /frames/{file} URL; without a project it writes a temp PNG path. Preview supports templates that lower to title.add or edit.add_shape; project-dependent templates report INVALID_ARGS honestly.

params.description: Template parameter overrides keyed by the template's declared params.

width.description: Optional preview width in pixels. Supply with height; defaults to the open project's width or 1280 with no project.

height.description: Optional preview height in pixels. Supply with width; defaults to the open project's height or 720 with no project.

frame_ms.description: Optional timestamp inside the resolved template duration; defaults to a visible mid/hold frame.

verbs.result: {id, preview_id, path, url?, mime:"image/png", width, height, frame_ms, params, lowering:{verb,args}, supported, warnings[]} — real PNG evidence, no op_ids.

verbs.name: generate.insert
verbs.description: Materialize one Generate template into the open project by resolving params, lowering to an existing native verb, and dispatching that verb through the normal replay-safe path. Inserts are grouped by an auto-checkpoint and return instance evidence: op ids, generated clip/asset ids, resolved params, lowering args, and the native verb result. Supported template verbs are title.add, edit.add_shape, and captions.kinetic. Requires an open project.

params.description: Template parameter overrides keyed by the template's declared params.

at_ms.description: Timeline start in milliseconds for templates that lower to a ranged insert. Defaults to 0.

track.description: Optional target track when the lowered native verb accepts a track argument.

rationale.description: Why this generated insert is being applied; threaded to lowered verbs that accept rationale.

verbs.result: {id, instance_id, checkpoint, op_ids, clips, assets, params, lowering:{verb,args}, result, restore_hint} — generated timeline instance evidence; op_ids includes the auto-checkpoint and native lowered op ids.

verbs.name: generate.from_prompt
verbs.description: Convert a natural-language visual/title/caption/card/social Generate request into a typed Generate plan, then optionally preview or insert it through generate.preview/generate.insert. Orchestrator only: no custom renderer and no direct timeline op of its own. Honest degradation: no adapter/agent backend -> status:not_run, no fake plan; malformed output -> status:error, no mutation.

prompt.description: Natural-language request for an editable Generate template instance.

policy.description: plan = return a typed plan only; preview = render a non-mutating PNG evidence frame; insert = materialize through generate.insert.

agent.description: Preferred prompt-planning backend for the adapter. auto lets the adapter choose.

template_id.description: Optional template hint from generate.list. The returned plan is still validated against the real catalog.

at_ms.description: Timeline/playhead time used for preview frame_ms and insert at_ms.

width.description: Optional preview width. Supply with height.

height.description: Optional preview height. Supply with width.

context.description: Optional caller context such as selected clip, transcript excerpt, brand hints, or target platform.

rationale.description: Human/agent rationale threaded to generate.insert when policy is insert.

verbs.result: {status, request, backend?, plan?, validation?, preview?, insert?, reason?, warnings[], next_actions[]} where policy plan mutates nothing, policy preview returns real image evidence, and policy insert returns normal generate.insert checkpoint/op/clip evidence.

verbs.name: generate.storyboard
verbs.description: Create or update a multi-scene Generate Storyboard plan from a prompt, director answers, script/outline, or existing-media context. policy:plan validates the Storyboard IR and never mutates the project; policy:preview renders per-scene PNG preview evidence for supported Generate template scenes and still mutates nothing; policy:insert materializes supported Generate template scenes through normal native Generate/native verbs and returns checkpoint/op/clip/asset/restore evidence. The result includes deterministic validation evidence, required agent skill path, missing input/questions, warnings, and next actions.

input.description: Prompt, brief seed, script, outline, or user request to turn into a multi-scene Generate Storyboard plan.

mode.description: Planning path. auto lets the adapter infer the path from input/context.

policy.description: plan validates only; preview renders non-mutating per-scene evidence; insert materializes supported scenes into the open project with checkpoint/restore evidence.

answers.description: Structured director answers already collected by Agent Chat or UI. Keys are brief fields; values can include stated/inferred source metadata.

context.description: Optional selected media, transcript availability, playhead, platform, brand hints, or Assemble outputs.

agent.description: Preferred planning backend for the adapter. auto lets the adapter choose.

rationale.description: Human/agent rationale for why this storyboard plan is being created.

verbs.result: {status, request, backend?, storyboard?, questions[], validation?, evidence:{policy, mutated, skill_path, scene_count, duration_ms, template_ids, brief_fields}, preview?, insert?, reason?, warnings[], next_actions[]}. policy plan mutates nothing; policy preview returns preview:{policy:'preview',mutated:false,scenes:[{scene_id,index,status,template_id,range_ms,preview_id,path,url,mime,width,height,lowering}],unsupported[],warnings[]}; policy insert returns insert:{policy:'insert',mutated:true,scenes:[{scene_id,index,status,template_id,range_ms,checkpoint,op_ids,clips,assets,lowering,restore_hint}],checkpoints,op_ids,clips,assets,restore_hint}.
